name: 3099-guidedjson-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1. One in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
architecture: Dense decoder (MistralForCausalLM), 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads (GQA), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, sliding-window 4096, vocab 32000, bf16, 7.24B params = 14.5 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 256 requests with a 2700 s safety cap, NO WARMUP. All 256 are submitted at once, so the run is a single wave; `max-num-seqs` is 256 to match, so nothing queues on the seat count.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, `request_format: plain` -- Mistral-7B-v0.1 is a BASE model with no chat template, so the prompt must not be wrapped. Prompt EXACTLY 52 tokens (min = max = 52) under this tokenizer with `add_special_tokens=False`; the engine sees 53 with its BOS, and nothing here reads the prompt text. EVERY REQUEST CARRIES THE SAME JSON SCHEMA as a structured-output constraint, written out in `scenario.json` under `spec.backend.sampling_params.structured_outputs.json`: four required properties -- `names`, `organizations`, `locations`, `miscellanous` (that spelling is intentional and must not be corrected) -- each an array of strings with `maxItems: 5`. `output_tokens` 128 is EXACT, not a cap: the backend sets `ignore_eos=True` whenever an output length is declared. `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A seven-billion-parameter entity extractor returning fixed JSON fields for 256 concurrent short prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.3.2-era EngineArgs: the argument surface is small, and a flag that does not exist at
# this commit fails to parse rather than being ignored. Do not add keys from a later vLLM --
# there is no --enable-prefix-caching, no --enable-chunked-prefill, no --max-seq-len-to-capture,
# no --num-scheduler-steps, and no structured-output flag of any kind.
#
# Nothing here is tuned. Anything not named below keeps the engine's own default at this commit.

model: mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1
# MACHINE-LEVEL, not a workload choice. `main`'s tokenizer.json now carries `Metaspace.split`, a
# field tokenizers gained in 0.19; the Feb-2024 stack this item pins has tokenizers 0.15.2 and
# dies parsing it ("data did not match any variant of untagged enum PyPreTokenizerTypeWrapper").
# This revision was current when the issue was filed, and its tokenizer.model is byte-identical
# to main's (sha256 dadfd56d766715c6...), so the vocabulary -- and therefore the compiled
# automaton -- is unchanged. Weights still come from `main`.
tokenizer-revision: 26bca36bde8333b5d7f72e9ed20ccda6a618af24
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 10000
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 256

error.text: our harness cannot attach the guided-decoding constraint this vLLM 0.3.2 workload needs (without it both versions would run the same unguided workload)
